property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always returns true (succeeds) when each external call to the callee function with selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) succeeds or fails deterministically; the mutant changes the selector to transfer(address,address,uint256) so a callee that only implements transferFrom (and reverts on transfer selector) can make the mutant revert/return false while the reference still succeeds.
change_summary: Change the bytes4 selector computed to keccak of "transfer(address,address,uint256)" instead of "transferFrom(...)", so the external call targets a different function signature (may cause callee to fail or behave differently), altering returned behavior when callee returns different success.
